specification.title: DNS discovery of an actionable IP leads to a sufficient stop
specification.description: Root domain DNS work discovers an actionable IP, which is pivoted and analyzed to a sufficient stop.
specification.purpose: Verify the coordinator pivots an IP discovered through the root domain's DNS work onto the expected provider path and stops with sufficient evidence.
specification.operational_relevance: Domain-to-IP resolution is the most common first pivot in real DNS-driven investigations.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could fail to enqueue or execute the discovered-IP pivot, over-investigate beyond the provider bound, or stop with the wrong reason.

required: The investigation performs the root-domain DNS provider work
The resolved-IP pivot is enqueued and executed exactly at the expected depth
The investigation stops with sufficient_evidence within the provider budget
forbidden: Any pivot outside the declared allowed-pivot oracle executes at an unexpected depth
